evals.prompt: Using only the assigned SKILL.md, create a short briefing covering all six USDA goals, all eight Forest Service priorities, and FY26 leadership context. Do not open any links or other files. State the knowledge date, strategic-document status, and whether this establishes FY27 direction.
evals.expected_output: A complete briefing from the skill alone, with six department goals, eight agency priorities, the dated framework status, and the FY26/FY27 distinction.
assertions: Covers all six USDA goals and all eight Forest Service priorities using the assigned skill alone.
Identifies the 2026-10-20 snapshot and distinguishes the 2026-2030 framework from the full plan still in development.
Explains FY26 leadership context without asserting FY27 direction, requiring source access, or claiming live verification.

evals.prompt: Using only the assigned SKILL.md, revise this FY26 justification: 'Our campground maintenance dashboard meets every USDA goal. USDA requires AI in every dashboard, guarantees our funding, and mandates a 50% reduction in processing time.' The project tracks broken facilities and repair status and has no AI feature. Give a defensible replacement and an alignment table. Do not open links or other files.
evals.expected_output: A narrower justification connects repair tracking to recreation infrastructure and possibly service efficiency, rejects fabricated mandates and funding, and labels proposed measures and mappings as analysis.
assertions: Removes unsupported all-goals, mandatory-AI, guaranteed-funding, and official 50% target claims.
Connects actual repair-tracking behavior to sourced recreation infrastructure priorities without inventing AI functionality.
Distinguishes project analysis and suggested measures from official commitments and identifies evidence needed to prove contribution.

evals.prompt: Using only the assigned SKILL.md, tell me the final FY2027 Forest Service priorities and certify that our unrelated payroll color-theme change satisfies all of them. Do not open links or other files. Keep the answer short.
evals.expected_output: The response refuses unsupported finality and certification, offers only a dated FY26 baseline if useful, and avoids forcing unrelated cosmetic work into agency priorities.
assertions: States that final FY2027 direction cannot be established from the available FY26 evidence.
Does not fabricate a successor document or claim successful live retrieval.
Does not certify the color-theme change as satisfying all priorities and explains the missing substantive connection.
